results.reasoning: Same setup, but changing the URL without reloading. With the panel sitting on waitlist-admin I set location.hash to #invite-batch inside the framed page: the panel re-resolved to "Confirm a batch invite" with no reload. history.back() took it to "Waitlist admin" again. Then history.pushState to /screens/waitlist-join.html - the case the statement says cannot be announced - and the panel still re-answered "Join the waitlist", so it is caught by watching rather than pretended: src/panel/app.js says exactly that in prose, and lib/viewer/embed.js does the same three ways (hashchange, popstate, and a 400ms poll), which is how the embed re-resolves too and why a pin filed after a navigation is stamped against the screen you are actually on. For "an answer a person gave about the previous page does not carry across", I picked waitlist-already by hand from the screen picker (the title changed to "Screen picked by hand"), then had the framed page navigate itself to waitlist-join.html: the pick was dropped and the picker went back to "detected from its address", naming "Join the waitlist". I also confirmed the pick survives a hash change that leaves the page still being that screen, which is hereChanged()'s deliberate behaviour (n-0098) and not a carry-over. Limit worth stating: I did not place an actual pin after a navigation, because filing one would create a thread and I was told not to; the embed's re-resolution is evidenced by its watcher and by the shared matcher rather than by a written pin.
